_comment: marble_tower: Map 2's guard tower, the Bentham drawing's -- ONE round stone shaft of constant diameter (r 7.0) on two low steps rising from the spike floor, opening at the guard floor into a colonnade of sixteen 0.30 m columns at bearings 25 + 22.5k (openings 36.25 + 22.5k, 1.70..7.00) that carry a ring beam and a dome (7.5..12.9) sitting directly on them; a 1.2 m balcony ledge round the shaft at z 1.10 (0.6 m under the room floor) with a 1.0 m railing of 32 iron posts, a mid and a top rail (rail top 2.10, under the guard's sight line to the lane, 2.35 at r 8.2). Origin = the guard-room datum as tower.glb: the room floor is z 1.70, the guard's eye 3.35, the foot z -26.35 (the spike floor, world y -1.0, when the scene's Tower node stands at y 25.35). One material, marble's packed 256 px atlas. MarbleTowerCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node (foot, steps, shaft, slab, ledge, an invisible band at r 8.12 from 1.10 to 2.10 in place of the railing, room floor, columns, ring beam closed with a flat ceiling; the dome is out of reach); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn. max_tris 3500: the railing (32 posts, two rails) is what a functional balustrade costs.
